_note: Recorded studio turns for eval/run_studio.py. '2026-11-08' is reconstructed from the hand-scored live run of that night (docs/test-phase/findings/AIT-live-2026-11-08.md): the raw outputs were not kept, so the fields are rebuilt from the findings - quoted phrases verbatim, the rest written to show the fault the findings name for that turn. 'worst-case' is written for this eval: each new case answered the way the 8 Nov faults would answer it (wrong desk, no urgency, a warning, the name, figures nobody gave), plus two good answers that must pass unchanged. Neither is a model's output; scoring them measures the checks and the code, never the model.
